summary_zh: 免费开源的文件转换器，支持拖放操作，可离线转换图片、PDF、Word、Excel、PowerPoint、HWP/HWPX、视频、音频、电子书、压缩包等多种格式；文件不会上传，结果保存在原文件旁，且无需安装 Office、Hancom Office 或 LibreOffice。
audience_zh: 适合需要在本机批量转换多种格式文件、注重隐私不上传文件、不想安装 Office 等办公套件的 Windows 10/11、macOS 13+（预览版）及 Linux x64/ARM64 用户。

evidence.quote: Free, open-source file converter. Convert 263 formats offline by drag & drop — images, PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, HWP/HWPX, video, audio, e-books and archives. No upload, no Office needed.
Images, PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, HWP, e-books, archives, fonts, CAD, 3D models and geospatial data work without Office, Hancom Office or LibreOffice.
- **Linux x64/ARM64** (Ubuntu 22.04+): unpack the package and run `./install.sh` (no root, needs Python 3).
